$comment: Only reach for this when an advisory that reaches the published artifact has
NO fix published upstream. Everything dev-only is already non-blocking, so an
entry here is never the way to quieten eslint or vitest noise.
package   the npm package name exactly as `npm audit` reports it
advisory  the GHSA id (preferred) or npm's numeric advisory source id
reason    why shipping with it is acceptable — the reachability argument,
not 'no fix yet'. This is the sentence a reader will judge.
added     ISO date the suppression was made
expires   ISO date it stops suppressing. Keep it short (30-90 days): past
that date the advisory blocks releases again, on purpose, so the
decision gets re-made rather than inherited.
An entry that no longer matches anything is reported as stale — delete it.
The healthy state of this file is an empty `allow` array.
